description: Use when a CTF challenge targets a machine learning model, a language model API, or an AI powered application in an authorized test environment. Covers the AI challenge workflow, prompt injection and jailbreak testing, indirect injection through documents and tool outputs, model extraction and membership inference, adversarial inputs for classifiers, and data exfiltration through model outputs. Use when a challenge gives you a chatbot, an image classifier, or a model endpoint and a flag hidden behind its guardrails, or when you need a systematic way to probe an AI system and capture the flag without breaking the challenge rules.
